RESOLVED 2026-10-09: Six Elrond+Hedera ops (/DeconstructTransaction, /GetAccountBalances, /IsValidImportAccount) that the spec documents without a 401 response declaration DO enforce apiKey at runtime - via ASP.NET ModelState [Required] on the apiKey query-string parameter, returning 400 not 401 before any handler runs. The missing-401 declaration is NSwag documentation drift (every ApiKey-missing response surfaces as 400 ModelState across the whole 641-op surface, including the ops that DO have a declared 401 - see A3 Elrond/GetTransactions). /api/v2/auth/sso?registerUrl=<attacker-url> reflects the raw registerUrl verbatim into the base64url-encoded `state` blob embedded in Google / Apple / Coinbase / Bitpanda OAuth URLs - however the SSO callback validates nonce FIRST (`ssoSessionMismatch`), so the attacker-controlled registerUrl never reaches a redirect code path with a crafted state alone. Would need to be chained with ssoNonce theft (XSS?) or a nonce bypass. Open thread; low priority. Raw: exploit/raw/sso-probe/results.json and exploit/raw/sso-cb-probe/results.json.

AUTH-SURFACE: /v2/auth/activate {code} is NOT Turnstile-gated. If activation codes are short (e.g. 6-digit numeric) and no server-side rate-limit, an attacker can race the just-registered victim to redeem the code before them. Entropy + rate-limit test needed; raw/app-auth, github/AUTH-SURFACE.md section 5.

2026-10-09 openapi-attack-map A1-A5 probes DONE on both blockchain-api + financial-api (10 ops x 2 hosts = 20 single probes, raw: exploit/raw/api-auth-gap/). All hypotheses REFUTED. A1 /General/Version returns 200 identical body on both hosts (version 2.0.9028.21725 byte-identical -> confirms same-image twin deploy, no build drift to raise). A2 Elrond+Hedera + A3 contrast + A4 xpub + A5 multichain fan-out ALL return 400 ModelState with 'apiKey field is required' as the first error. The spec's missing-401-declaration gap is documentation drift only: runtime enforces apiKey via ASP.NET ModelState [Required] at parameter-binding time, before any handler executes - which also explains why declared-401 contrast op (A3) returns 400 not 401. No 200-with-data, no 500 stack trace, no 403 CF challenge, no 404 delta. Next-session: these 10 ops are RULED OUT as unauth-reachable; next hunting ground is the authenticated apiKey-holder posture (apiKey predictability / enumeration / cross-tenant leakage via kyt_txdb_id IDs in responses). Matrix: exploit/raw/api-auth-gap/MATRIX.md.

key_findings_offline: /api/General/Version is the ONLY op the spec declares as apiKey-free. Confirms host reachability + exposes build version.
6 Elrond + Hedera ops declare NO 401 response (/DeconstructTransaction, /IsValidImportAccount, /GetAccountBalances on each chain). Suggests apiKey check may be absent at runtime on those two chains.
Hedera_IsValidImportAccount parameter doc uses the Elrond erd1 regex (copy-paste bug). If the backend handler is also copied, Hedera input validation is broken.

TaxToolEvmTransaction leaks internal integer IDs (kyt_txdb_id int64, kyt_contract_id int32, blockchain_id, currency_id). These are IDOR seeds for sibling cn.blockpit.io / bit-api endpoints that accept the same IDs.
34 xpub/ypub/zpub endpoints: a single apiKey + a single xpub de-anonymises an entire wallet across all derived addresses.
/api/General/GetMultichainAddressesByAddressList fans one call into 66 chain RPCs - the most expensive single operation. If apiKey-free, resource abuse at scale.
ResponseModelOfObject.result and TaxToolToken.details are free-form object fields (empty inline schema). Potential arbitrary-JSON injection channels from upstream RPCs.
Spec declares schemes:[http] on TLS-only hosts - spec-authoring drift, not a live hole.

netlify_surface.slug_discovery_method: DNS CNAME via Google DoH (raw/cname-doh.txt) - deterministic, no guessing needed
netlify_surface.lock_bypass_summary: 0/8 locked custom-domain hosts bypassed at slug level. Netlify enforces password at the <slug>.netlify.app layer as well (401 identical body, 8296B). Classic 'edge-only lock' misconfig does NOT apply to this account.
